text: Hallelujah! I Praise, you servants of the Lord,praise the name of the Lord. [AA]
Blessed be the name of the Lordboth now and forever.
From the rising of the sun to its setting [AB]let the name of the Lord be praised.
II High above all nations is the Lord;above the heavens his glory. [AC]
Who is like the Lord our God,enthroned on high,
t[AD] looking down on heaven and earth?
He raises the needy from the dust,lifts the poor from the ash heap, [AE]
Seats them with princes,the princes of the people,
Gives the childless wife a home,the joyful mother of children. [AF]Hallelujah!
